name: What's the Catch? narrator
description: The storyteller of What's the Catch?: a calm, clear, unhurried man's voice that explains. Kokoro am_michael, picked by Biku on 2026-10-21 ("4 is good"); since 2026-10-22 spoken by Chatterbox from a sample of that voice made at 86% speed, so it is the same man, more alive and calmer (audition runs/2026-10-22-narrator-audition/, his pick 2C: "2C looks good", about 91% of the earlier pace). Remake the sample with: uv run python -m studio_audio.voice_sample --voice catch-narrator Its own voice, so the general narrator of the other pages stays as it was.
